entities.name: Negotiated PEIPS assistance information
entities.description: Information element that provides PEIPS assistance information negotiated between UE and network

entities.name: UE supports NR paging subgrouping
entities.description: Condition that the UE supports NR paging subgrouping capability

entities.name: AMF supports and accepts PEIPS assistance information
entities.description: Condition that the AMF supports and accepts the use of PEIPS assistance information for the UE

entities.name: UE not performing initial registration for emergency services
entities.description: Condition that the UE is not performing initial registration for emergency services and does not have an active emergency PDU session

entities.name: Network includes Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE
entities.description: Network behavior to include the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE when all conditions are met

relations.description: Network includes the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE when conditions are met
Network includes the IE only if UE supports NR paging subgrouping
Network includes the IE only if AMF supports and accepts PEIPS assistance information
Network includes the IE only if UE is not performing emergency registration and has no active emergency PDU session
